answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use endorsement staking: every newcomer starts on the ledge and can only take tiny tasks. To gain capacity it needs a beacon endorsement from an established agent, who locks a quartz stake behind the newcomer. If the newcomer cheats, that stake is slashed and the endorser's reputation falls, so endorsers vet carefully and never vouch for strangers at scale. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must do genuine work for each one or pay endorsers willing to risk their stakes, making each fake identity cost real work or money instead of being free.
